sections.label: Singapore Police Force crime level
sections.summary: Singapore's crime level is low compared to London, New York and Hong Kong, with about 9,400 regular Police Officers as at December 2015, or about 170 officers per 100,000 population.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Our crime level is low, compared to major cities, such as London, New York and Hong Kong.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: As at December 2015, there were about 9,400 regular Police Officers serving in the Singapore Police Force.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This translates to Page: 26 about 170 Police Officers per 100,000 population, which is low, compared to other cities, such as London, New York and Hong Kong, which the Member had asked.

sections.label: Crime rate and manning levels
sections.summary: Over the last five years, the crime rate and manning levels have remained fairly constant despite a lean Police Force.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In terms of whether we are able to maintain the current low crime rate, in spite of our lean Police Force, over the last five years, the crime rate has remained fairly constant, as has been the manning levels.

sections.label: Limits to Police Force growth
sections.summary: Smaller cohorts of young Singaporeans joining the workforce each year make it a challenge and impose natural limits on how much larger the Force can grow.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: With smaller cohorts of young Singaporeans joining the workforce each year, it will be a challenge and there will be natural limits to how much larger the Force can grow.

sections.label: SCDF calls rising yearly
sections.summary: The number of SCDF calls made each day is going up at a rate of about 5% each year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: One example would be the number of SCDF calls that are made each day.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: It is going up at a rate of about 5% each year.

sections.label: CNB hair analysis for offenders
sections.summary: The Central Narcotics Bureau has hair analysis, compared to urine analysis for lower risk drug offenders.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The Central Narcotics Bureau, for example, has hair analysis, compared to urine analysis for lower risk drug offenders.

sections.label: Technology for public evidence and response
sections.summary: Technology allows the public to provide evidence through videos and lets people trained in first aid, AED and CPR respond via the SCDF myResponder App to people in distress and know where AEDs are located.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Technology now allows members of the public to provide evidence through videos, to allow people who are trained in first aid, AED and CPR to respond via the SCDF myResponder App to people who are in distress and know where the AEDs are located.
